# Association Register

The Association Register is an operational building block called during the zero-trust authentication and authorization process.

## 3. Concepts

<table data-view="cards"><tbody>
<tr><td><strong>Association</strong></td><td>Legal entity that serves as a trust anchor for both federated trust/authentication and local onboarding. A BDI Association is the "home Association" for its Members.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Association Register</strong></td><td>Technological solution for the register of recognized legal entities, realtime accessible by associated data provider(s): the members.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Member</strong></td><td>Legal entity as member of the BDI Association of its choice</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Outsider</strong></td><td>Member of a different BDI Association than the "home" association. Members of the same instance are insiders, anybody else is an Outsider and vice versa.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Preferred Business Partners</strong></td><td>Outsiders who have agreed to specific terms and conditions of a local BDI Association that maintains its own Business Partner Reputation Model</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Home Association</strong></td><td>The association that the member is a part of.</td></tr>
<tr><td><strong>Visitor</strong></td><td>Outsider with a better reputation score than a defined minimum.</td></tr>
</tbody></table>

An Autorization Register may be shared as well. This requires that an Outsider, Visitor or Partner identifies the URL of its root Association. It particularly supports the building blocks Authentication and Certified roles.
